### Del Monte Corporation Showcases Reunited Brand and New Product Innovations at 2026 IFPA Global Produce & Floral Show


October 14, 2026


*Longtime exhibitor returns with a unified fresh and shelf-stable portfolio following the brand’s reunification after nearly 40 years; six new products debut at booth #1642*


CORAL GABLES, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Del Monte Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.delmontecorporation.com%2F&esheet=54621243&newsitemid=20261014109032&lan=en-US&anchor=Del+Monte+Corporation&index=1&md5=18f18c0d6f31b3e5b8eeed132ee985ef) (NYSE:DMC), previously known as Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc., one of the world’s leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable food products, will return to the IFPA Global Produce & Floral Show in Orlando, Fla., Oct. 15-16, with its first unified showcase of fresh and shelf-stable offerings since its acquisition of select Del Monte Foods assets. Building on the company’s longstanding presence at the show, this year’s exhibit marks a new chapter for the Del Monte® brand, reunited under one global owner for the first time in nearly 40 years. Attendees can explore the expanded portfolio and get an exclusive first look and taste of six new products at booth #1642.


“The Global Produce & Floral Show has long been an important platform for showcasing the strength of our fresh portfolio and deepening our customer relationships,” said Danny Dumas, Senior Vice President, Sales, Marketing & Product Management, North America, Fresh Division, Del Monte Corporation. “This year, we’re proud to build on that presence alongside our Foods colleagues, bringing customers a broader portfolio and a more coordinated approach to serving their needs. Our latest fresh innovations reflect that same customer focus, combining our expertise in premium fruit and fresh-cut products with convenient new ways for consumers to enjoy Del Monte throughout the day.”


“Our foods business brings longstanding retail relationships and products that generations of families have trusted in their kitchens,” said David Stis, Chief Commercial Officer, Foods Division, Del Monte Corporation. “Reuniting the Del Monte brand allows us to build on that foundation alongside our Fresh colleagues, giving customers a broader portfolio backed by a brand consumers already know and trust. At IFPA, we’re presenting that combined strength together and showing how our teams can help customers create new opportunities for growth by meeting consumers’ needs throughout the day, with convenient options that fit their lives at home and on the go.”


The company will debut six new products at the event:


- **Del Monte Red & Green Chimichurri** premium sauces are expertly crafted with fresh herbs and vegetables for a bright, authentic taste experience. Versatile and full of flavor, they can be used as marinades, toppings or dipping sauces to transform any meal.
- **Del Monte Açaí Parfait** is a vibrant blend of açaí, fresh fruit, creamy yogurt and crunchy granola, conveniently packaged in a single-serve cup and packed with 6g of protein for satisfying, on-the-go snacking.
- **Del Monte Fruit Kabobs** are a fun, easy-to-eat kabob-style assortment of fresh-cut strawberries, pineapple, honeydew melon, cantaloupe and watermelon.
- **Del Monte Watermelon Feta Salad** includes juicy sliced watermelon and crisp cucumber paired with feta crumbles and a drizzle of balsamic vinaigrette for a refreshing, flavor-packed combo.
- **Del Monte Premium Snack Fruit Trio Tray** is designed for fruit lovers with chunks of our signature Honeyglow ® pineapple and premium Pinkglow ® pineapple, along with sweet cantaloupe in this ready-to-enjoy pack.
- **Del Monte Medjool Dates** are exceptionally large, soft and naturally rich with a caramel-like sweetness. Hand-harvested at peak ripeness and grown in a premier region in the Jordan Valley, they’re designed to cultivate superior size, texture and flavor.


Beyond these fresh innovations, the company will highlight one of the first product collaborations between its Fresh and Foods teams: bringing its well-known **Del Monte Gold Pineapple** into convenient new formats. Building on a heritage of quality pineapple known for its consistent sweetness, taste and freshness, the lineup features single-serve chunks and multi-serve chunks and spears in 100% juice, giving consumers more ways to enjoy the pineapple they know and trust at home, at work and on the go.


Attendees of the Global Produce & Floral Show are invited to sample these retail-ready offerings at **booth #1642** . For product inquiries or additional information, please contact Ivan Brown **** at ****IBrown@FreshDelmonte.com .


**About Del Monte Corporation**


[Del Monte Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdelmontecorporation.com%2F&esheet=54621243&newsitemid=20261014109032&lan=en-US&anchor=Del+Monte+Corporation&index=2&md5=335294be69a59bc9b8df41e8026fceef) (NYSE: DMC) is one of the world’s leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable food products, with products sold in more than 90 countries worldwide. As the global owner of the Del Monte® brand, subject to certain existing licensing arrangements, the company operates across fresh produce, fresh-cut fruit and vegetables, refrigerated foods and shelf-stable categories, serving consumers around the world with a portfolio built on quality, innovation and trust.


Formerly Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc., the company changed its corporate name to Del Monte Corporation in June 2026, reflecting its expanded role as steward of one of the world’s most recognized food brands and its commitment to unlocking new opportunities for growth, innovation and global brand expansion.


The Del Monte® brand has been a symbol of quality, freshness and reliability for more than 135 years and is the No. 1 canned vegetable brand in the United States, according to Circana1. Del Monte Corporation is not affiliated with certain other Del Monte companies around the world, including Del Monte Asia Pte. Ltd. The company is the first global marketer of fruits and vegetables to commit to the Science Based Targets initiative and has been recognized as one of America’s Most Trusted Companies by Newsweek and named a Humankind 100 Company by Humankind Investments.


Del Monte Corporation is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol DMC.


1 Circana, Canned Vegetables, Total U.S., Last 52 Weeks Ending Aug. 2, 2026, based on dollar sales.
